name: Tetsuya
source:
A young man who works part-time at a grilled meat restaurant that the hostesses visit frequently after their shift late at night. Tecchan is hard worker with a refreshing personality,
he is a fellow hostess and popular among their group. He is one of those young people who came to the big city chasing their dreams. Tecchan wants to be a dancer and works hard for it.
 
[Translated from [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20060207232233/http://www.aquarium-soft.com/aquarium/iyashite/hansoku.htm]Official Website[/url].]
